name: Deli Roast Beef Stew with Sauerkraut, Potatoes, Carrots & Peas

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add half of the green onions (reserving the rest for serving), shredded carrots, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain sauerkraut in a colander.

When the carrots have softened, add sauerkraut, broth, and shredded potatoes to the pot; stir to combine the stew and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
6 cups frozen shredded hash brown potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, stack roast beef slices one on top of another, then medium dice.
When the potatoes are tender, add roast beef and peas to the stew. Stir to combine and continue to cook until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stew between bowls. Top with reserved green onions and enjoy!
